name: Databot
author: jesusdev

sections.description:
Databot allows you to add a smart chatbot to your WordPress site quickly and easily. Improve customer support and user experience with a virtual assistant available 24/7.

Main Features

  • Easy integration with your Databot.cl account
  • Simple configuration from the WordPress admin panel
  • Compatible with all WordPress themes
  • Customizable chatbot according to your needs
  • Smart automatic responses
  • Available 24/7 for your visitors
  • Friendly and modern interface

How it works?

  1. Register at Databot.cl
  2. Create and configure your chatbot
  3. Get your Bot ID and API Key
  4. Install the plugin in WordPress
  5. Enter your credentials in the settings
  6. Ready! Your chatbot will be running on your site

Support

If you have any questions or need help, visit Databot.cl or contact our support team.

Additional Information

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Active account at Databot.cl

Privacy

This plugin connects to external services from Databot.cl to function:
* https://databot-api.herokuapp.com/dist_files/databot.js
* https://databot-api.herokuapp.com/dist_files/databot.css

Conversation data is processed according to the Databot.cl privacy policy.

Credits

Developed by the Databot team.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for ‘Databot’
  3. Click ‘Install Now’
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to ‘Databot’ in the side menu
  6. Enter your Bot ID and API Key

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’ > ‘Upload Plugin’
  3. Select the ZIP file and click ‘Install Now’
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to ‘Databot’ in the side menu
  6. Enter your Bot ID and API Key

Configuration

  1. Go to Databot.cl
  2. Register or log in
  3. Create your first chatbot or go to the ‘Chatbot’ tab
  4. Click on the ‘Implement’ (Implementar) button
  5. In the popup window, select the ‘WordPress’ tab
  6. Copy your Bot ID and API Key
  7. Paste them into the plugin settings in WordPress
  8. Save changes
sections.faq:
Do I need an account at Databot.cl?

Yes, you need to register at Databot.cl to create your chatbot and obtain the necessary credentials (Bot ID and API Key) to connect the plugin.

Is it free?

You can check the available plans and prices at Databot.cl. Generally, there are free plans with basic functionalities and paid plans with advanced features.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Databot is compatible with all WordPress themes. The chatbot is automatically integrated into your site without needing to modify your theme.

Can I customize the chatbot design?

Yes, you can customize the design and behavior of your chatbot from your panel at Databot.cl.

Does it affect my site speed?

No, the plugin loads scripts in an optimized way (defer) so as not to affect your website’s performance.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

When you uninstall the plugin, all saved settings will be automatically removed from your database. Your chatbot on Databot.cl will remain intact.

Does it work on multisite?

The plugin is compatible with standard WordPress installations. For multisite networks, each site will need its own configuration.

Where does the chatbot appear?

The chatbot automatically appears on your site, usually as a floating button in the bottom right corner. The exact position depends on your chatbot configuration at Databot.cl.
